data.body: Audited fishy-dinky-urus at immutable BASE d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84 and authored FINAL 05ea2fe764dfb520ee594034270614aff5d8decb. Posted a validated 99-row TSV receipt (99 unique/10 fields; 99 bloat+directive PASS, 95 semantic PASS, 4 semantic FAIL; 7,413->2,284 words), SHA-256 c326d72021ed8dbcd56a87a4e8c42d3939b38e9af771ba7b78d80b7bc600d4da. Reproduced the four failures: preview_criterion's 0.050s timeout returned after 0.361s due executor shutdown; two blocks therefore overstate bounded/responsive behavior; resolve_value supports omitted secrets expressions; code-review coach is an agent step without temperature override. Reconciled ACs to 5/6, leaving the independent semantic-PASS criterion open. Did not consume plan-review/completion capacity because completion evidence is not satisfied. Resume only after a comments-only corrective Gerrit change for those four blocks is merged and independently re-audited; then run review-plan, verify-completion --ref <corrective-merge-sha>, and transition against that same ref, never force.
